independent_computation.summary: The leaf is not a physics quantity. It is a classification/presentation structure (a map of {disposition, view_tag} pairs). No cached wiki text and no formula in docs/math-foundations.md defines, constrains, or yields such a map, so no value for this leaf can be derived from the permitted sources. What can be established is (a) hard negative evidence that the concept is absent from every source, (b) that no principled derivation of the entry count 178 exists in the cached data, and (c) that 178 is not refuted as an order of magnitude for a 60-unit coupled Syndra timeline.

candidate_domains_tested.domain: Syndra JSON leaves / ability leaves / stat leaves
SR-legal, purchasable, no championRestriction, no acquisitionNote (the CLAUDE.md rule-6 availability triple)

step_3_entry_count_search.brute_force: Enumerated all 2047 conjunctions of 11 natural item predicates (SR mode, purchasable, no champion restriction, no acquisition note, no requiredChampion, no requiredAlly, has effects, not trinket, not consumable/potion, not minion/turret, no sourceWarnings). Exactly 16 conjunctions land in 177-179, collapsing to two distinct 178-member sets: {SR and hasEffects and not consumable/potion} and {SR and no championRestriction and hasEffects and not trinket}. The two sets differ by 18 members (symmetric difference includes 3901/3902/3903 Gustwalker-line, 3330 Scarecrow Effigy, 3340/3363/3364 trinkets, 2003/2031/2055 consumables). Both admit TURRET and MINION rank items (7 + 5) that no player build can hold, so neither is a defensible 'items an ordinary SR build may hold' set under CLAUDE.md rule 6. Conclusion: hitting 178 by item filtering is a coincidence of the search space, not a derivation.
step_3_entry_count_search.conclusion: 178 has no principled derivation from the cached data. The map's domain cannot be identified from the permitted sources.

step_4_order_of_magnitude_sanity_check.result: Syndra alone authors on the order of 52 + 23 = 75 primary events before multi-hit expansion, DoT tick partitions, item procs and per-defender re-pricing. A coupled scenario re-prices every participant pair (data/atoms/autoresearch-review.md: 'the coupled ledger re-prices defenders past the first (defender_index > 0)'), so a per-event disposition map in the 150-200 range is consistent in magnitude. 178 is therefore not refuted, but neither is it pinned - any count in that band would be equally consistent.

verdict_reasoning.why_not_both_wrong: 'both_wrong' asserts positive knowledge that the 178-entry map is incorrect. No permitted source contradicts it: the term does not appear in the cache, no derivable count refutes 178, and the order-of-magnitude check for a 60-unit coupled Syndra timeline is consistent with a map of that size.
verdict_reasoning.why_not_old_value_correct: 'old_value_correct' asserts the leaf should remain absent. Absence of a golden leaf is not a positive claim about game behavior, and nothing in the wiki cache or math-foundations.md requires this field to be unemitted. Objecting to snapshot surface area would be a design opinion, not an oracle finding.
verdict_reasoning.why_new_value_correct: The remaining verdict is the one consistent with the evidence: the new value stands unrefuted. This is an unrefuted-not-verified result, not a confirmation.
verdict_reasoning.caveat: This leaf is outside the oracle's competence as scoped by R-18/R-19. A {disposition, view_tag} map is engine/presentation classification metadata; it has no wiki text or quoted formula behind it. Entry-level correctness (which key carries which disposition, and which view_tag) cannot be checked from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md by construction, and should be gated by a schema/enumeration test in the engine's own suite rather than by a source oracle.
